verdict: ADP Workforce Now: Choose ADP Workforce Now when mid-market payroll compliance and HR records are the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need Gusto’s published SMB prices or Workday-class HCM. recommendation: Choose ADP Workforce Now when mid-market payroll compliance and HR records are the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need Gusto’s published SMB prices or Workday-class HCM. overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, enterprise HCM, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
